profile.headline: Web Developer at TopSpot Internet Marketing
profile.summary: I love to be challenged in both intellectual and creative ways. Both my left and right brain are active and I am always looking to challenge both sides whether it be learning a new programming language, or trying my hand at a form of traditional art. I am always seeking to build upon my skills and hope to one day be in a place that can satisfy my needs for enrichment for both sides of my brain.

positions.title: Director of Technology
positions.description: Lead developer responsible for developing websites, researching and deploying technologies, managing other developers, and taking care of hardware and software for internal uses.

positions.title: Multimedia Designer
positions.description:
- Create graphics for print and web
- Build and manage websites
- Create designs for printing/embroidering onto merchandise
- Create designs for future toys

positions.title: Design Coordinator
positions.description: manage the fulfillment and delivery of web design projects primarily with the Wordpress platform.

positions.title: Jr. Administrator
positions.description: As a Jr. Administrator, I am the front line support via chats and phone calls. I Assist with both technical and non-technical aspects of Hostgator's products and our customer's websites. I am always striving for a first-contact resolution for customers and fixing their issues the way they desire.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I help provide a web presence for Epic! Gaming Lounge in order to assist them in reaching out to potential future customers in the DFW area. I work with WordPress making use of HTML/CSS/PHP for the development as well as Adobe Creative Suite for the design.

positions.title: Operations Assistant
positions.description: Printing orders, locating parts, and building kits for various HP computer products. I would often work with delicate computer parts for servers and computers such as hard drives, processors, motherboards, and memory.Then packaging, and sending them off for shipping.

projects.title: Epic! Gaming Lounge Website
projects.description: Epic! Gaming Lounge is an upcoming gaming lounge/internet cafe for the DFW area who is currently being sponsored by companies such as Gamestop and Maingear. This website was developed in WordPress so that the owners could easily access and modify any information whenever needed. The aesthetics are reflective of the owners's desired image for the company.
